title: 公共施設のピクトグラム
lead: 駅・病院・トイレ・エレベーターなど、公共施設を表すピクトグラム12点です。案内図やチラシに使えます。
subject_en: simple monochrome pictograms of public-facility signs in the style of Japanese public guidance symbols: bold geometric silhouettes in white-cream on a rounded square in deep blue, one clear symbol per item, very simple shapes. Each item is a separate small subject centred in its cell with space around, never touching another. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates, clouds) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a standing person and a skirted person side by side
a box with an up arrow and a down arrow and a tiny person
a person walking up a flight of steps
a cross inside a building outline
a front view of a train with two windows
a bus side view next to a pole
a question mark on a round counter
a car side view with a roof
a running person heading to a door
a person seated in a wheelchair
